alteredSource.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Dreamerie Version 4 spot-the-difference source painting. Image 1 is the edit target: a blue whale carrying a glass conservatory, orange trees, teapot, suspended goldfish bowl and flowering branches. Preserve the 1672x941 framing, original painterly matte finish, colors, lighting and every unmentioned detail. Make ONLY five distinct localized, believable changes: (1) The whale's near pectoral fin curls up and partly cradles the hanging goldfish bowl without breaking the bowl or whale anatomy, a clear new relationship. (2) A thin stream from the hanging teapot lands inside the conservatory's open roof vent rather than onto the wisteria, with one continuous stream and the rest unchanged. (3) The conservatory's red entrance door stands slightly ajar and the nearest rail passes behind it rather than across it. (4) The goldfish's tail in the suspended bowl curls around the bowl's inner painted moon reflection, not through the glass; keep one fish. (5) On the top orange tree, the three closest fruit stems braid into one short shared stem instead of separate stems, with natural branch structure. No extra edits, model-wide repaint, blur spots, text, grain or watermark.
